critique: The wood board and restrained club interface feel coherent, but the result is intentionally conservative and close to a familiar chess-app template. All pieces and squares receive nearly identical emphasis, and the side panel has little content-specific personality beyond serif headings.
suggestion: Develop a distinctive modern-club identity through bespoke piece silhouettes, subtle rank/file ornament, and meaningful turn or last-move emphasis; give the side panel tournament-card details and material indicators that add character without compromising classical legibility.
audit_note: Direct Codex critic output grounded in the shared r0 screenshot; not an API raw-response object.
